text:
alex: Heads-up — vendor sent updated ETA for the H200 rotation batch, moved from 5/10 -> 5/18 for EU pool. impact: 160 GPUs delayed.
leah: thanks. can we stagger replacements from the loaner pool to avoid pod OOMs?
sanjay: we have ~40 loaners in FRA and 30 in AMS. can sustain degraded throughput for 48-72h if we sequence drains.
alex: plan: 20/day from FRA -> replace failing nodes, then AMS. need depot ETA for RMA pickups before 5/20.
carrier-liaison: vendor confirms depot pickup window 5/16-5/21 but requires final serial manifest by 5/13 COB.
jordan: serial manifest is missing ~12 IDs from the last shipment, working with warehouse to reconcile.
leah: also pricing note: vendor offered a ~1.8% credit for late delivery on this batch; finance needs that number in the PO amendment.
alex: logistics ask: if vendor splits the replacement AWB, customs will apply separate duties -> potential €8k delta. ops-bot: flagged potential tariff variance.
ops-bot: AUTO: create ticket INF-6721 for tariff variance approval (assigned to leah).
sanjay: cluster health: we already have two degradation alerts in eu-west-1 because of thermal throttling on older H100s. rotation should prioritize those racks.
jordan: agree — schedule replacements to cover eu-west thermal nodes first, then scale up batching in other regions.
carrier-liaison: vendor requests RMA authorizations per depot. Can we provide per-serial RMA codes? that adds 2-3 days to prep.
leah: we can batch-authorize up to 25 serials per manifest. for >25 we need depot-level PO amendment. recommend batching by depot to hit manifest deadline.
alex: tradeoff: either accept manifest split (customs cost) or ask vendor to issue consolidated RMA (prep delay). which is cheaper?
jordan: quick calc — consolidated RMA delay (3 days) vs customs split (€8k + 1 day). consolidated delay cheaper but risks cluster pressure during weekend.
sanjay: we can mitigate with temporary autoscale bump on dedicated pools for 48h (estimate additional cloud/GPU cost ~ $12k).
leah: finance: credit 1.8% on PO reduces net spend by ~$9.6k — close to autoscale cost. so consolidated RMA + autoscale looks net neutral.
alex: decision: ask vendor for consolidated RMA, confirm they can accept manifest by 5/16, and we will schedule autoscale bump for 5/18-5/20 as contingency.
carrier-liaison: vendor replied: consolidated RMA possible but requires QA hold removal at their depot (photo evidence) — they can commit if we sign waiver for refurbished coverage.
jordan: waiver ok for refurbished units only; need approval from legal. tagging @leah for signoff.
leah: looping legal offline now. I'll push for minimal warranty adjustments and confirm by EOD.
ops-bot: REMINDER: infra-maint window scheduled 5/18 02:00-06:00 UTC for canary drains.
sanjay: coordinate canary drains to coincide with replacements in eu-west to avoid double impact.
alex: i'll put together a timeline and PV (procurement variance) note for finance/legal. will post updated manifest once warehouse reconciles missing serials.
jordan: update: warehouse found 9 serials, still 3 missing — reaching out to forwarder for last-mile scan.
carrier-liaison: forwarder acknowledges 3 items on hold in customs; target clear by 5/12.
leah: great — if customs clears by 5/12 we keep consolidated path. otherwise fallback to split AWBs and finance will invoice customs delta against vendor credit. :+1:
alex: thanks team. posting final timeline in #eng-runtime when legal confirms waiver.
ops-bot: AUTO: ticket INF-6721 updated — vendor consolidated RMA requested; legal signoff pending.
